text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of our Hatsumode 
visit!

The dedication the two carried for this 
year burned hotter than anyone's. The 
three of us headed to the shrine to make 
our New Year's prayers.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen. In order to 
become the best version of myself by the 
time I run alongside Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, before making a wish to the gods, 
I want to first think about how I'll run 
this year!

To plan out the rotation, I first needed 
to re-evaluate Kitasan Black's unique 
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My strengths... I realized it last year. 
At first glance, there's nothing about me 
that stands out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A sharp late surge, a captivating race 
development, and star quality too. But...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just take the lead and give it your all 
until the very end! Even with that 
approach, you can steadily build up your 
skills and gain more supporters.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then how should I run...?

"...I think it over. If the margin of 
growth is small... we'll just have to make 
up for it with volume."

Kitasan Black's greatest strength is her 
extraordinary toughness. In that case, for 
this spring, we should first—
choice_data_list: Let's enter all three spring G1s!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Three... GⅠs! All of them... You mean all 
the big medium-distance and longer races!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah—the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), 
and Takarazuka Kinen.

Yeah, the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), 
and Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.text:
If she runs well in all three of these 
races, the expectations surrounding her 
will surely—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It sounds super rewarding! Though, that 
might still not be enough!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: May I keep going all the way to the end?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to see the consecutive race plan 
you came up with through to the very end, 
Trainer. All the way to the Arima Kinen, 
where I'll run with Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After the Takarazuka Kinen comes the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and then the 
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Can I make running six GⅠ races in a row 
my goal? Please! Even if it's reckless, 
I...!

"A battle of numbers relying on sheer 
grit. If it's Kitasan Black, I'm sure she 
can run hard all the way through the whole 
year."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First is the Osaka Hai. And if we can run 
a good race at the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
next—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I might place high in the Takarazuka Kinen 
fan vote too. Hopefully better than my 3rd 
place in last year's Arima—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: 1st place... in the fan vote? Trainer...

I cannot back down here. Even without 
natural flashiness, I must show that I can 
stand at the very top in popularity as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, 1st place! In both popularity and 
skill, 1st place is my goal. And then...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like Dad, I'm going to become an 
Umamusume of true substance and 
brilliance!

And so, this year's plans were set, and 
the shape of her wish became crystal 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, looks like you've decided. Now 
let's pray together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The "Senior Year Royal Road 6 G1 
Series"...! I'll run my best in every 
single one and make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, a 'GⅠ victory.' May we 
fulfill our long-cherished wish and shine 
the brilliance of Satono upon everyone!"

A wish surging up from the earth, and a 
wish shining down from the heavens. Though 
different in form—

Both shared the exact same feeling. A 
desire to contribute to someone as an 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best with both.
Let's do our best with both.

text_block_list.text:
The Hatsumode visit ended without a hitch, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well Dia-chan, how about we do that thing 
we do every year? Our New Year's showdown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You two are always competing over 
something. We also have the Arima Kinen at 
the end of the year, so before that...

Apparently, competing over something at 
the start of the new year is a tradition 
for the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, since we have the chance, why 
don't we have Trainer decide what kind of 
match we'll have today?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's true. Trainer-san, please give 
us something we can give our absolute all 
to!

"Then let's race!" felt a bit lacking in 
holiday spirit. A contest befitting the 
New Year would be...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fukuwarai...! That game where you make 
funny faces, right? Then Dia-chan, let's 
play it at my house!

—And so, I paid a visit to Kitasan Black's 
family home...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm~... the eyes go here, and the nose is 
here! How's that?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, Kita-chan, what is that face, 
ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How do you even make a funny face like 
that~? No fair~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that funny? When you laugh 
that much, Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahaha...! Your laugh is so 
contagious~. Ahahahahaha!

The two of us burst into laughter. Our 
quick game of Fukuwarai seemed to serve as 
a nice change of pace.

And so, New Year's came to an end, and 
Kitasan Black proudly made her start 
toward her first goal, the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Winter swimming...?! All right, let's 
settle this in the pool! I won't lose, 
Dia-chan!

And so, the two of them competed in 
swimming—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a great swim! Though Dia-chan, 
the strokes we're good at are completely 
different, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll do the crawl and backstroke...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"For me, it's breaststroke and butterfly. 
And I guess the horse paddle, too."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, since we're here, why don't we 
teach each other our best swimming 
strokes?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I've always wanted to try the horse 
paddle!”

Different upbringings, different swimming 
styles. The two taught each other how to 
swim, learning how to use their bodies in 
return.

And so, New Year's came to an end, and 
Kitasan Black proudly made her start 
toward her first goal, the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
New Year's mountain climbing... So we'll 
be racing in a trail run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Trail run"...? So that's what it's 
called. Well, since it's New Year's and 
all, let's challenge a mountain we usually 
wouldn't climb!
And so, our destination was—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, running on snowy mountains is so 
hard~. But I won't lose, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The way you use your legs is 
completely different. This might be even 
better training than the uphill course!

"By running through the snowy winter 
mountains together, the two of them seem 
to have gained valuable insights into 
their running."

And so, New Year's came to an end, and 
Kitasan Black proudly made her start 
toward her first goal, the Osaka Hai.
